policies.text: An air transport carrier is cleared for executive charter contracts if it holds preferred provider designation and maintains minimum passenger liability coverage of 30,000,000 USD.
A lodging venue qualifies for luxury listing if it maintains an accommodation rating of at least 4.5 stars and provides 24-hour desk coverage.
A freight distributor receives priority customs clearance when maintaining a fleet compliance score above 95% and zero cargo loss incidents over 12 months.

An air transport carrier is awarded preferred provider designation either by demonstrating a yearly punctuality percentage of at least 90%, operating an active aircraft count of no fewer than 10, holding valid ISO 9001 quality management certification, and recording under 2 yearly safety infractions, or by holding valid Platinum Flight Operations Accreditation.
An air transport carrier is selected to handle corporate travel operations provided it is cleared for executive charter contracts.
A ground transit provider gains top-tier shuttle endorsement when its customer feedback score reaches at least 4.5 points.
